open_points.subject: A13 rule 6 mapped value-list persistence
open_points.text: “written when the list is first delivered” no longer says which action or module writes the StoredValue
open_points.question: Which action is responsible for persisting a mapped node’s delivered value list, including when it is reconstructed after restart: run advancement only, a generic value-delivery operation, or a reader that first derives it?
options: The request or startup recovery advancing the run writes it through the store module
A generic value-delivery operation writes it, regardless of which action caused delivery
The first trace or run reader that derives the list may write it lazily
open_points.default_guess: The request or startup recovery advancing the run writes it through the store module.
